description: This file defines the class `GetEndpointIdsRequest`, which extends `DeviceRequest`, and models a request for retrieving endpoint IDs from a Zigbee device in the mock Zigbee core testing framework.

classes.name: GetEndpointIdsRequest
classes.description: A request class to retrieve endpoint IDs from a `MockZigbeeDevice`. It extends `DeviceRequest` and overrides the `executeDeviceRequest` method to send back the endpoint IDs as a response.

methods.name: GetEndpointIdsRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request with a request ID and device EUI64, and specifying the response type.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the device request by retrieving endpoint IDs from the given `MockZigbeeDevice` and sending the response.
